description: Source code for dump_syms.cc, a component of Google's Breakpad project used to create symbol files for minidumps, including functions for reading object files, handling Mach-O binaries, DWARF debug info, and generating symbol modules.

classes.name: DumpSymbols
classes.description: Main class for reading object files, extracting debug info, and generating symbol modules.

classes.name: DumpSymbols::DumperLineToModule
classes.description: Helper class to convert DWARF line info into module line data.

classes.name: DumpSymbols::LoadCommandDumper
classes.description: Handles Mach-O load commands to load debug sections into a Module.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::Read
methods.description: Reads the object file, handling dSYM bundles if present.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::SetArchitecture
methods.description: Sets the target architecture based on CPU type/subtype.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::SetArchitecture(const std::string&)
methods.description: Sets architecture based on architecture name string.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::Identifier
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for the binary.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::ReadDwarf
methods.description: Reads DWARF debug info sections into a Module.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::ReadCFI
methods.description: Reads call frame information sections into a Module.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::ReadSymbolData
methods.description: Creates a Module with debug info by parsing the object file.

methods.name: DumpSymbols::WriteSymbolFile
methods.description: Outputs the symbol data to a stream.
